title: Function templates
recap: A function template describes a family of functions parameterized by type. Instantiation creates a concrete function when a particular type is needed.
Use operations supported by every tested type. A generic maximum needs comparison and copying but should not force a numeric-only conversion.
objectives: Implement the stated behavior for multiple inputs.
Run the visible tests and explain one boundary case.
warnings: The function/type interface is fixed, but implementation syntax is your choice.
Do not remove the visible tests; the checker keeps an independent copy.
Respect the stated input domain and lifetime/range rules.
challenge: Implement maxOf<T>(left,right), returning the larger value, or the first value when equal. The provided template parameter T lets the same body work for int, double, and std::string. Return T, not int, so text and fractional values survive.
hints: Return one of the original values without conversion.
Equal values should take the first-value path.
